title: af.perf-builds/6
description: Per-side build provenance of one run, builds.json (ADR-0166, ADR-0169): the isolation (a trusted host process, or a pinned build image without network), source and its verified embedded commit, the authority overlay, every adapter outcome in priority order, both sides' adapter bindings, binary, artifact and Cargo.lock hashes, the verified toolchain and linker, sanitized argv and environment, bounded logs, budgets, cleanup, and every recipe setting each side and the shared supervisor were built with.
